confidence: HIGH on identity, legal continuity, active operation, the February 2025 chart and Pilot business-line perimeter; LOW on cutoff owner identities, stakes and vehicles
summary: Keep the existing Extenet production record deferred without a database or seed mutation. Direct evidence resolves ExteNet Systems, Inc., ExteNet Systems, LLC and Extenet as one continuing platform; verifies its active operating scope and Lisle headquarters; proves the February 13, 2025 42% Stonepeak / 32% KH Killington / 26% Other Members cap table; confirms that the ESL/ELVS transfer was abandoned; and confines Pilot's August 2026 closing to the Enterprise Fiber business. It does not establish the September 4, 2026 owner set, stakes and vehicles, bridge JH Killington to KH Killington, or resolve Northleaf's, DigitalBridge's and Manulife's cutoff positions or the outcome of the reported outdoor DAS and small-cell sale process.
resolvedFormerBlockers: A direct filed conversion notice proves that ExteNet Systems, Inc. became ExteNet Systems, LLC effective 2021-12-30 without a merger, asset transfer or service interruption; Extenet is the operating rebrand of the same platform.
The live company page directly verifies an active communications-infrastructure platform headquartered in Lisle, Illinois.

The direct February 13, 2025 Kentucky PSC chart proves the Mount Royal holding chain and the exact dated member table of 42% Stonepeak Communication Holdings LLC, 32% KH Killington Communications, LLC and 26% Other Members, with no individual Other Member at 20% or more.

The direct 2020 New York PSC petition proves that JH Killington Communications, LLC was owned and controlled by John Hancock Life Insurance Company (U.S.A.), a Manulife subsidiary, and the direct consummation notice proves that transaction closed 2021-03-31.
The direct New York PSC rescission proves that the ExteNet Systems LLC / ExteNet LVS asset transfer was not and will not be completed.

The direct Pilot closing release proves an Enterprise Fiber business-line sale effective 2026-08-15, including former Hudson Fiber Network and Axiom Fiber Network assets, rather than a platform-equity sale.
The reported June 2026 outdoor DAS and small-cell process is distinguishable from a completed platform transaction; no signed or closed outcome was found.
